fees.note: Priority fee is the observed median across recent slots; the typical-fee figure models a 200k-CU transaction.

activity.note: no public endpoint served getBlock for the sampled slots

protocols.tvl_sum_note: The per-protocol sum runs higher than the headline chain TVL because DeFiLlama strips double-counted value (liquid-staking tokens redeposited as lending collateral, and similar) from chain totals but reports it in each protocol's own figure. Both numbers are correct; they answer different questions.

tokenized_assets.note: Tokenised real-world assets and equities on Solana, summed from DeFiLlama categories Basis Trading, RWA, RWA Lending, Tokenized Equities, Treasury Bonds. This is locked value, not traded volume - keyless per-venue equity volume is not published.

rev.definition: REV proxy = DeFiLlama chain-level fees for Solana (24h). Chain revenue is the retained share. Strict REV (base + priority fees + MEV tips) requires block-level accounting unavailable keylessly.

roadmap.why_curated: Named protocol milestones have no machine-readable feed. The live SIMD pull-request queue and the Agave release feed in the same report are fully automated; this list is the human layer, and it carries a review date so staleness is visible rather than silent.

milestones.name: Alpenglow
milestones.summary: Replaces TowerBFT and Proof-of-History-based consensus with Votor + Rotor, targeting sub-second (~150 ms) finality and moving voting off-chain to cut validator vote costs.

milestones.name: Firedancer
milestones.status: Frankendancer in production; full client rolling out
milestones.summary: Jump Crypto's independent validator client written in C. Client diversity is the point: a bug in one implementation should not stop the chain.

milestones.name: SIMD-0096 / priority fee routing
milestones.summary: 100% of priority fees go to the block producer rather than half being burned, changing validator economics and the shape of the fee market.

milestones.name: SIMD-0228 (market-based emissions)
milestones.summary: Would tie SOL issuance to the staking participation rate rather than a fixed disinflation curve. Watch the SIMD queue in this report for successor proposals.

milestones.name: Increased block limits
milestones.summary: Successive raises to the per-block compute unit ceiling, lifting throughput headroom ahead of Alpenglow's consensus changes.

milestones.name: Token Extensions (Token-2022)
milestones.summary: Confidential transfers, transfer hooks and permanent delegates - the feature set institutional and tokenised-asset issuers ask for.

derived._note: Derived figures combine two or more independent sources collected in the same run.

findings.title: Stake concentration is high
findings.detail: Nakamoto coefficient is 18: that many validators together control over a third of active stake.
